delta_judgment.test_fix: TestLoadUpstreamCAsEscapes builds want from filepath.Abs("/no") + separator and expects U+FFFD for the 0xff byte on Windows. Matches the Windows conversion (syscall.FullPath via UTF-16 replaces 0xff with U+FFFD; GetFullPathName gives C:\no\such...) and the native log's got line (branch-3733c4b-go-test.log:15). Unchanged expectation on Linux/darwin, so broken escaping still fails. Product unchanged; design 1003-1005 stays true.

findings.lines: driver/session.go (LoadUpstreamCAs, scanCAFile, ClaimRelay); driver/hostutil.go (ModuleRoot); cmd/warden/config.go (configFile, readConfigFile)
findings.what: Carried forward. A security-boundary change: trust roots sent across host-relay as re-encoded valid PEM only, the user-level config file removed, ModuleRoot found from the executable only, the default config file read only if regular and up to 1 MiB. The design carries the Security note (What remains, 10). The delta (guide text and a test expectation) adds nothing to the boundary.
findings.fix: No code change. The human acknowledges at merge with the Security note in the PR body; TEST-08's adversarial arm runs before the release that carries it.
